newsitem.title: UK: Nomura plans overseas unit shake-up-report.
newsitem.headline: Nomura plans overseas unit shake-up-report.

text.p: Japanese securities group Nomura plans to restructure its overseas divisions in a bid to make them more effective against western investment banks, said the Financial Times on Monday.
The report said Nomura planned to switch from regional organisation to a centralised global structure, sub-divided into product lines, according to Junichi Ujiie, Nomura president.

He told the FT in an interview "We have some strong areas, such as securitisation. But in other areas we are behind groups like Merrill Lynch and Goldman Sachs. That is because we do not have an integrated global distribution system."
The news comes after the Japanese government banned Nomura from parts of the domestic market for several months for its connections with sokaiya -- the Japanese corporate racketeers.
The Nomura president said he planned to unveil the plans at a meeting of branch managers in September.
